column4: Enter the keyboard bootloader to flash firmware. Normal typing stops until the keyboard restarts.
Restart the keyboard firmware without entering the bootloader.
Reinitialize the keyboard EEPROM, resetting persistent settings. This can erase saved keymap configuration depending on the firmware.
Swap Caps Lock and left Ctrl in the keyboard firmware.
Restore the normal mapping of Caps Lock and left Ctrl.
Swap left Ctrl and left Gui in the keyboard firmware.
Restore the normal mapping of left Ctrl and left Gui.
Swap right Ctrl and right Gui in the keyboard firmware.
Restore the normal mapping of right Ctrl and right Gui.
Swap Ctrl and Gui on both sides in the keyboard firmware.
Restore the normal mapping of Ctrl and Gui on both sides.
Toggle the firmware swap of Ctrl and Gui on both sides.
Swap left Alt and left Gui in the keyboard firmware.
Restore the normal mapping of left Alt and left Gui.
Swap right Alt and right Gui in the keyboard firmware.
Restore the normal mapping of right Alt and right Gui.
Swap Alt and Gui on both sides in the keyboard firmware.
Restore the normal mapping of Alt and Gui on both sides.
Toggle the firmware swap of Alt and Gui on both sides.
Swap Grave and Escape in the keyboard firmware.
Restore the normal mapping of Grave and Escape.
Swap Backslash and Backspace in the keyboard firmware.
Restore the normal mapping of Backslash and Backspace.
Make Caps Lock act as Ctrl in the keyboard firmware.
Stop treating Caps Lock as Ctrl.
Disable the Gui keys. Gui is Command on macOS and Windows or Super on other systems.
Enable the Gui keys. Gui is Command on macOS and Windows or Super on other systems.
Toggle whether the keyboard sends the Gui keys.
Enable N-key rollover when supported by the keyboard and host.
Disable N-key rollover.
Toggle N-key rollover when supported by the keyboard and host.
Save this split keyboard half as the left half. Requires firmware configured for EE_HANDS.
Save this split keyboard half as the right half. Requires firmware configured for EE_HANDS.
Enable all keyboard audio, including click sounds and music mode.
Disable all keyboard audio, including click sounds and music mode.
Toggle all keyboard audio, including click sounds and music mode.
Enable music mode, where keyboard keys play musical notes. Requires audio support.
Disable music mode, where keyboard keys play musical notes. Requires audio support.
Toggle music mode, where keyboard keys play musical notes. Requires audio support.
Cycle the keyboard music mode through its configured scales.
Toggle generated click sounds on each keypress. Requires keyboard audio support.
Raise the pitch of generated keyboard click sounds.
Lower the pitch of generated keyboard click sounds.
Restore the default pitch of generated keyboard click sounds.
Enable haptic feedback when supported by the keyboard.
Disable keyboard haptic feedback.
Toggle keyboard haptic feedback.
Restore the default haptic feedback configuration.
Cycle haptic feedback between keypress, key release, and both.
Toggle solenoid buzz. Requires a solenoid haptic driver.
Select the next haptic waveform. Requires a DRV2605L driver.
Select the previous haptic waveform. Requires a DRV2605L driver.
Toggle continuous haptic feedback. Requires a compatible driver.
Increase continuous haptic strength. Requires a DRV2605L driver.
Decrease continuous haptic strength. Requires a DRV2605L driver.
Increase solenoid activation time. Requires a solenoid haptic driver.
Decrease solenoid activation time. Requires a solenoid haptic driver.
Decrease the Auto Shift hold timeout.
Increase the Auto Shift hold timeout.
Type the current Auto Shift timeout value.
Enable Auto Shift, which shifts supported keys when held past the timeout.
Disable Auto Shift.
Toggle Auto Shift, which shifts supported keys when held past the timeout.
Enable combo processing in the keyboard firmware.
Disable combo processing in the keyboard firmware.
Toggle combo processing in the keyboard firmware.
Toggle Caps Word, which capitalizes letters until a word-breaking key is pressed. Exact continuation keys depend on firmware configuration.
Repeat the last key with its modifiers.
Send the alternate of the last key. Alternates depend on the firmware configuration.
Toggle the keyboard backlight.
Cycle through keyboard backlight brightness levels.
Toggle the keyboard backlight breathing animation.
Set the keyboard backlight to its maximum brightness.
Turn off the keyboard backlight.
Increase keyboard backlight brightness.
Decrease keyboard backlight brightness.

Send Escape normally, or Grave when Shift or Gui is held. Firmware settings can change the modifier overrides.
Hold for left Shift; tap for an opening parenthesis. Space Cadet behavior depends on firmware settings.
Hold for right Shift; tap for a closing parenthesis. Space Cadet behavior depends on firmware settings.
Hold for left Ctrl; tap for an opening parenthesis. Space Cadet behavior depends on firmware settings.
Hold for right Ctrl; tap for a closing parenthesis. Space Cadet behavior depends on firmware settings.
Hold for left Alt; tap for an opening parenthesis. Space Cadet behavior depends on firmware settings.
Hold for right Alt; tap for a closing parenthesis. Space Cadet behavior depends on firmware settings.
Hold for right Shift; tap for Enter. Space Cadet behavior depends on firmware settings.
Toggle the lock on the highest active layer. Requires Layer Lock support.
Hold to enable the lower Fn layer, plus the adjust layer when FN_MO23 is also held. Defaults are layers 1 and 3; firmware configuration can change them.
Hold to enable the upper Fn layer, plus the adjust layer when FN_MO13 is also held. Defaults are layers 2 and 3; firmware configuration can change them.
Start recording dynamic macro 1 on the keyboard.
Start recording dynamic macro 2 on the keyboard.
Finish recording the current dynamic macro.
Play dynamic macro 1 from the keyboard recording buffer.
Play dynamic macro 2 from the keyboard recording buffer.
